call_sites: none in nova/ (no production runtime caller)

findings.text: non-blocking: stationary_cells re-implements the nearest-generator cell selection already owned by fixed_points._CachedField._location (nova/equilibrium/fixed_points.py:279) and by topology's wall_cell argmax (nova/equilibrium/topology.py:3325); it neither extends nor wraps either owner, so a future change to how a cell is chosen has to be made in three places or the tracked cell silently stops agreeing with the cell the fit is evaluated in.

non-blocking: the accuracy assertion compares the read's position against `roots`, the same array the test passes into read() as its seeds and previous point, so a read that returned its initial guess unchanged would satisfy it; the recorded negative control (axis 0.3049 m off) is what currently rules that out, and the test itself does not.

non-blocking: the stage log's first line reads 'tracked-read H200 measure' while the job ran on a titan P100, so a reader of the log cannot tell that no H200 wall exists and that section 2's 0.2 ms H200 bound is still unmet at the measured 1.531 ms; the manifest labels the device correctly, the log does not.

non-blocking: the baseline arm's '# revision:' header stamps 4398ff4e3, a commit that already contains the node's own change, for a tree (/tmp/reckon-crew-scratch/.../base) that carries no TrackingState, because run_arm.sh stamps the worktree's HEAD rather than the tree it runs; a reader comparing revisions alone would see no delta between the arms.

non-blocking: the negative control's own provenance line names the unmutated worktree's fixed_points.py, not the mutant tree named on line 2 and named by the PYTHONPATH on line 4, so the log does not itself establish that the mutated module was the one imported; the mutant tree does carry the declared averaging change, so this reads as a defective provenance line rather than a false red, but the artefact cannot prove which.

non-blocking: the manifest sets status: complete while its own blockers line (:38) states an unmet condition and outside_scope lists the four-state accuracy table, the H200 wall and the qualification-gate repair as not delivered, so the two fields disagree about whether the node's brief was met.

non-blocking: the fragment describes the no-rebuild probe as moving the X-point 'about 0.1 pitch' while tests/test_tracked_read.py:113-115 constructs the displacement as 0.2 * pitch, so the evidence document understates the shift its own test performs.

justifications.evidence: logs/focused_head.log records '4 passed in 112.57s' EXIT=0 for the gate the done-when names, and logs/negative_control_averaged_fit.log records the accuracy test red at EXIT=1 with the axis 0.3049 m from the analytic extremum, so the gate is shown to fail on a degraded fit rather than only to pass.
justifications.fit: The change follows the module's NamedTuple idiom and adds no plan or ticket name, but nova/equilibrium/support_read.py:216 reaches into the private topology._inside_cells across a module boundary and :156 recomputes a mesh-sized argmin on every call.
justifications.goal_fidelity: nova/equilibrium/support_read.py:226-251 rebuilds the connected-domain decision only when a tracked cell or the saddle ownership changes, which is the goal's tracking clause, but no route under nova/ calls read(), so 'the fast route's only read' is unwired and the cell-local fit is fixed_points._CachedField (fixed_points.py:279) rather than the stencil_nulls owner the reuse map names.
justifications.reuse: stationary_cells at nova/equilibrium/support_read.py:156 re-implements the nearest-generator cell selection that nova/equilibrium/fixed_points.py:279 (_CachedField._location) and nova/equilibrium/topology.py:3325 (wall_cell) already own, without extending or wrapping either.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 6ccf43de9a42..ef45dd0a0131 touches only tests/test_tracked_read.py, scripts/prototypes/tracked_read, the evidence fragment and nova/equilibrium/support_read.py, the last of which the source brief's 'Shared file' paragraph instructs be edited and the manifest reports in scope_note.
